  • The handler data is valid only during the call.

docs.text: All notable changes to this project are documented in this file. The format is based on Keep a Changelog, and this project adheres to Semantic Versioning.

docs.title: Added
docs.text:
• Repository skeleton from the SystemFromScratch® library blueprint (CMake, presets, CI workflows, VS Code tasks, documentation site and PDF manual tooling).
  • Public API contract (headers only, no implementation yet):
  • inc/sstep_config.h: build-time configuration (numeric backend, topologies, microstep limit, sine table size, argument checks), each value range-checked;
  • inc/sstep_defs.h: status codes, topologies, fault flags, driver states;
  • inc/sstep_math.h: backend types (Q15 int16_t or float), per-unit convention, 32-bit electrical angle;
  • inc/sstep_ctrl.h: configuration structures in integer engineering units, hardware callbacks given at initialisation, fast/slow loop functions, motion commands.
  • CMake cache variables SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND (FIXED/FLOAT) and SSTEP_CONFIG_DIR.
  • tests/compile/sstep_api_check.c: compile check of the API with an example configuration (17HS19-2004S1 on B-G431B-ESC1).
  • Numeric backend (inc/sstep_math.h, src/sstep_math.c):
  • saturating static inline operations for both backends (add, sub, neg, abs, mul, clamp, accumulator add/clamp, gain multiply), identical ranges in both backends;
  • struct sstep_gain (Q15 mantissa + exponent, or float) and sstep_gain_from_ratio(), sstep_real_from_ratio(), sstep_real_to_units() for conversions from engineering units without floating point;
  • sstep_sin_cos(): quarter-wave table with linear interpolation; the table (src/sstep_sin_table.c) is generated by tools/sstep_gen_sin_table.py.

  • Preset [UnitTestsFloat]Stepper Motor Control; [UnitTests]Stepper Motor Control builds the fixed point backend.

  • Control implementation (both numeric backends):

  • sstep_init(): validation of every configuration field, per-unit gains from engineering units without floating point (Kp = L wc, Ki = R wc, back-calculation Kb = Ts R / L, ADC scaling, back-EMF feed-forward; 2 pi = 710 / 113);
  • fast loop: ADC conversion, overcurrent / overvoltage / undervoltage trips, PI current control with Q27 integrators (fixed point) and back-calculation anti-windup, voltage drive mode, averaged power stage for two H-bridges and for three legs with a common leg (voltage vector scaled with its direction kept, bus voltage compensation);
  • slow loop: integer motion generator (positions in 1/65536 microstep, exact discrete braking: no overshoot, exact stop on the target), hold current, events, bus voltage scale; angle interpolated in the fast loop;
  • slow -> fast hand-off through a double buffer (no torn reads on a single core);
  • commands: move to / by, run, stop, set position (rotor angle kept), currents, motion limits, faults, status.
  • sstep_gain_from_ratio64() (at most three 64-bit divisions), integrator type sstep_integ_t, sstep_gain_mul_acc(), sstep_div_unit(), sstep_acc_scale(), sstep_acc_to_ticks().
  • No dependency on <string.h>.

docs.text:
• Unit tests tests/unit/gtest_sstep_math.cpp (18 tests): 100 % line and branch coverage of src/sstep_math.c and of the inline operations, in both backends.
  • Measured sin/cos error, default table (8 bits): fixed point 1.0 LSB (3.05e-5), float 4.7e-6.
  • Unit tests of the power stage, motion generator, API and closed loop with a motor model (tests/unit/sstep_test_plant.hpp): 76 tests (fixed point), 75 (float); 100 % line and branch coverage of src/ in both backends (gcov); clean under ASan and UBSan.

docs.title: Integration Guide
docs.text:
The library does not touch hardware. An integration has three parts:

  1. Receive: move bytes from the transport into sstep_link_receive() from a thread or the main loop, not from an interrupt handler.
  2. Transmit: a write function that sends a complete frame; serialize it if several threads send.
  3. Application: a handler that interprets frames and answers.

Complete, buildable programs for each pattern are described in Examples.

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Every macro has a default and may be overridden in one of two ways: * on the compiler command line (-DSSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND=SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FLOAT), or * in a user header sstep_user_config.h, included when the macro SSTEP_USER_CONFIG is defined (CMake: set SSTEP_CONFIG_DIR to its folder).

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Execution model. One driver instance (struct sstep) controls one motor. The application calls two functions periodically:

Function Rate Context Work sstep_fast_loop() fast_loop_hz (PWM rate or an integer fraction of it) PWM / ADC interrupt current control, voltage limit, topology mapping, PWM write sstep_slow_loop() slow_loop_hz (typically 1 kHz) main loop or a timer task trajectory, microstep angle, hold current, fault handling

All other functions are called from the same context as sstep_slow_loop(). The library never reads a clock, never blocks, allocates no memory and has no global state: time is given by the configured loop rates.

Hardware access is done only through the callbacks in sstep_callbacks, given once to sstep_init(). Measurements are passed to sstep_fast_loop() as raw ADC counts.

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
Units. Configuration values are integers in engineering units (milliohm, microhenry, milliampere, millivolt, hertz, nanosecond) so that sstep_init() needs no floating point with the fixed point backend. The unit is part of every field name (r_mohm, l_uh...). Positions are in microsteps, velocities in microsteps per second.

Sign convention. A positive phase voltage drives a positive phase current; positive velocity increases the position. Phase A leads phase B by 90 electrical degrees for positive motion.

docs.title: Detailed Description
docs.text:
The control code is written once against these types and operations; the backend is selected at build time with SSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND.

Per-unit signals. Inside the control loops every electrical signal is normalised to a base value computed by sstep_init(): * current: 1.0 = power stage current full scale (i_full_scale_ma), * voltage: 1.0 = nominal bus voltage (vbus_nominal_mv), * duty cycle: 1.0 = 100 %.

Both backends therefore see values in about -1..+1, which makes Q15 exact enough and lets the two backends be compared sample by sample in the tests.

Type Fixed point backend Float backend sstep_real_t int16_t, Q15 (1.0 = 32768, range -1 .. +0.99997) float, same range sstep_acc_t int32_t, Q15 with 16 integer bits (range +/-65536) float, same range sstep_angle_t uint32_t, one electrical turn = 2^32 same struct sstep_gain Q15 mantissa and binary exponent float

Same behaviour in both backends. Every operation saturates to the ranges in the table instead of overflowing, in both backends, so that a test can compare them. Angles wrap by design.

Speed. The per-sample operations are static inline and branch-light; the fixed point backend uses only 32-bit multiplications (no 64-bit arithmetic), so it suits Cortex-M0. Functions that convert engineering units (*_from_ratio, sstep_real_to_units()) use 64-bit integers and division: call them at initialisation or from the slow loop, not from the fast loop.

#include "sstep_config.h"
#include "sstep_defs.h"
#include "sstep_math.h"

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/* ==============================================================================
 * CALLBACK TYPES
 * =============================================================================*/

typedef int (*sstep_pwm_write_fn)(void* context, const uint16_t compare[SSTEP_LEGS_MAX]);

typedef int (*sstep_output_enable_fn)(void* context, bool enable);

typedef void (*sstep_fault_fn)(void* context, uint16_t faults);

enum sstep_event
{
    SSTEP_EVENT_MOVE_DONE = 0,   
    SSTEP_EVENT_HOLD_CURRENT = 1 
};

typedef void (*sstep_event_fn)(void* context, enum sstep_event event);

/* ==============================================================================
 * CONFIGURATION TYPES
 * =============================================================================*/

struct sstep_callbacks
{
    void* context;                        
    sstep_pwm_write_fn pwm_write;         
    sstep_output_enable_fn output_enable; 
    sstep_fault_fn on_fault;              
    sstep_event_fn on_event;              
};

struct sstep_motor_cfg
{
    uint32_t r_mohm;             
    uint32_t l_uh;               
    uint32_t i_rated_ma;         
    uint32_t ke_uv_s_per_rad;    
    uint16_t full_steps_per_rev; 
};

struct sstep_stage_cfg
{
    enum sstep_topology topology; 
    uint32_t vbus_nominal_mv;     
    uint32_t vbus_min_mv;         
    uint32_t vbus_max_mv;         
    uint32_t i_full_scale_ma;     
    uint32_t i_trip_ma;           
    uint16_t pwm_period_ticks;    
    uint32_t pwm_freq_hz;         
    uint32_t dead_time_ns;        
    uint16_t adc_i_zero;          
    int32_t adc_i_span;           
    uint32_t adc_vbus_mv_full;    
    uint16_t adc_full;            
};

enum sstep_drive_mode
{
    SSTEP_DRIVE_CURRENT = 0,
    SSTEP_DRIVE_VOLTAGE = 1
};

struct sstep_ctrl_cfg
{
    enum sstep_drive_mode drive_mode; 
    uint32_t fast_loop_hz;            
    uint32_t slow_loop_hz;            
    uint16_t microsteps;              
    uint32_t current_bw_hz;           
    uint32_t i_run_ma;                
    uint32_t i_hold_ma;               
    uint32_t hold_delay_ms;           
    uint32_t v_max;                   
    uint32_t accel;                   
    uint32_t decel;                   
};

struct sstep_config
{
    struct sstep_motor_cfg motor;   
    struct sstep_stage_cfg stage;   
    struct sstep_ctrl_cfg ctrl;     
    struct sstep_callbacks hal;     
};

/* ==============================================================================
 * MEASUREMENT AND STATUS TYPES
 * =============================================================================*/

struct sstep_sample
{
    uint16_t i_a; 
    uint16_t i_b; 
    uint16_t vbus; 
};

struct sstep_status
{
    enum sstep_state state; 
    uint16_t faults;        
    int32_t position;       
    int32_t target;         
    int32_t velocity;       
    int32_t i_a_ma;         
    int32_t i_b_ma;         
    uint32_t vbus_mv;       
};

/* ==============================================================================
 * DRIVER INSTANCE (PRIVATE)
 * =============================================================================*/

struct sstep_setpoint
{
    sstep_angle_t angle;        
    int32_t dangle;             
    sstep_real_t i_amp;         
    sstep_real_t ff;            
    struct sstep_gain inv_vbus; 
};

struct sstep_motion
{
    int64_t pos;          
    int64_t target;       
    int64_t brake_vmax;   
    int32_t vel;          
    int32_t v_run;        
    int32_t v_max;        
    int32_t acc;          
    int32_t dec;          
    uint8_t mode;         
};

struct sstep
{
    struct sstep_config cfg;          
    /* Constants derived by sstep_init() */
    struct sstep_gain kp;             
    struct sstep_gain ki;             
    struct sstep_gain kb;             
    struct sstep_gain r_pu;           
    struct sstep_gain adc_i;          
    struct sstep_gain adc_v;          
    struct sstep_gain ff_gain;        
    sstep_real_t i_run;               
    sstep_real_t i_hold;              
    uint16_t i_trip_counts;           
    uint16_t vbus_min_raw;            
    uint16_t vbus_max_raw;            
    uint16_t ratio;                   
    uint32_t hold_ticks;              
    uint8_t angle_shift;              
    /* Slow loop -> fast loop hand-off (double buffer) */
    struct sstep_setpoint sp[2];      
    volatile uint8_t sp_active;       
    volatile uint8_t sp_pending;      
    /* Fast loop state */
    struct sstep_setpoint cur;        
    uint16_t adv;                     
    sstep_integ_t integ[2];           
    sstep_real_t i_meas[2];           
    volatile uint16_t vbus_raw;       
    uint16_t compare[SSTEP_LEGS_MAX]; 
    /* Slow loop state */
    struct sstep_motion mo;           
    sstep_angle_t angle_offset;       
    uint32_t still;                   
    bool hold_active;                 
    struct sstep_gain inv_vbus;       
    volatile uint16_t faults;         
    volatile enum sstep_state state;  
};

/* ==============================================================================
 * PUBLIC FUNCTION DECLARATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

int sstep_init(struct sstep* m, const struct sstep_config* cfg);

int sstep_enable(struct sstep* m);

int sstep_disable(struct sstep* m);

int sstep_fast_loop(struct sstep* m, const struct sstep_sample* sample);

int sstep_slow_loop(struct sstep* m);

int sstep_move_to(struct sstep* m, int32_t position);

int sstep_move_by(struct sstep* m, int32_t delta);

int sstep_run(struct sstep* m, int32_t velocity);

int sstep_stop(struct sstep* m);

int sstep_set_position(struct sstep* m, int32_t position);

int sstep_set_current(struct sstep* m, uint32_t run_ma, uint32_t hold_ma);

int sstep_set_motion_limits(struct sstep* m, uint32_t v_max, uint32_t accel, uint32_t decel);

int sstep_report_fault(struct sstep* m, uint16_t faults);

int sstep_clear_faults(struct sstep* m);

int sstep_get_status(const struct sstep* m, struct sstep_status* status);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* SSTEP_CTRL_H */

#ifndef SSTEP_MATH_H
#define SSTEP_MATH_H

/* ==============================================================================
 * INCLUDES
 * =============================================================================*/

#include <stdint.h>

#include "sstep_config.h"

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/* ==============================================================================
 * TYPE DEFINITIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

typedef uint32_t sstep_angle_t;

#if (SSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND == SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FIXED)

typedef int16_t sstep_real_t;

typedef int32_t sstep_acc_t;

struct sstep_gain
{
    int16_t mant; 
    int8_t exp;   
};

#define SSTEP_REAL_FRAC_BITS 15

#define SSTEP_REAL_MAX ((sstep_real_t)INT16_MAX)

#define SSTEP_REAL_MIN ((sstep_real_t)INT16_MIN)

#define SSTEP_ACC_MAX ((sstep_acc_t)INT32_MAX)

#define SSTEP_ACC_MIN ((sstep_acc_t)INT32_MIN)

#define SSTEP_ACC_C(x) ((sstep_acc_t)((x) * 32768.0))

typedef int32_t sstep_integ_t;

#define SSTEP_INTEG_FRAC_BITS 27

#define SSTEP_REAL_C(x)                                                                 \
    (((x) >= 1.0) ? SSTEP_REAL_MAX : (((x) <= -1.0) ? SSTEP_REAL_MIN                     \
                                                    : (sstep_real_t)((x) * 32768.0)))

#else /* SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FLOAT */

typedef float sstep_real_t;

typedef float sstep_acc_t;

struct sstep_gain
{
    float value; 
};

#define SSTEP_REAL_MAX (0.999969482421875f)

#define SSTEP_REAL_MIN (-1.0f)

#define SSTEP_ACC_MAX (65535.99609375f)

#define SSTEP_ACC_MIN (-65536.0f)

#define SSTEP_ACC_C(x) ((sstep_acc_t)(x))

typedef float sstep_integ_t;

#define SSTEP_REAL_C(x)                                                                 \
    (((x) >= 1.0) ? SSTEP_REAL_MAX : (((x) <= -1.0) ? SSTEP_REAL_MIN : (sstep_real_t)(x)))

#endif /* SSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND */

#define SSTEP_REAL_ZERO SSTEP_REAL_C(0.0)

#define SSTEP_ACC_ONE SSTEP_ACC_C(1.0)

#define SSTEP_ACC_IN_MAX SSTEP_ACC_C(3.999969482421875)

#define SSTEP_ACC_SCALE_MAX SSTEP_ACC_C(1.999969482421875)

#define SSTEP_GAIN_EXP_MIN (-16)

#define SSTEP_GAIN_EXP_MAX 15

struct sstep_sincos
{
    sstep_real_t sin; 
    sstep_real_t cos; 
};

/* ==============================================================================
 * FIXED POINT OPERATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

#if (SSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND == SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FIXED)

static inline int32_t sstep_asr(int32_t x, uint32_t n)
{
    int32_t result;
    if (x >= 0)
    {
        result = (int32_t)((uint32_t)x >> n);
    }
    else
    {
        result = -(int32_t)((uint32_t)(-(x + 1)) >> n) - 1;
    }
    return result;
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_sat(int32_t x)
{
    int32_t r = x;
    if (r > (int32_t)INT16_MAX)
    {
        r = (int32_t)INT16_MAX;
    }
    else if (r < (int32_t)INT16_MIN)
    {
        r = (int32_t)INT16_MIN;
    }
    else
    {
        /* in range */
    }
    return (sstep_real_t)r;
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_add(sstep_real_t a, sstep_real_t b)
{
    return sstep_sat((int32_t)a + (int32_t)b);
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_sub(sstep_real_t a, sstep_real_t b)
{
    return sstep_sat((int32_t)a - (int32_t)b);
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_neg(sstep_real_t a)
{
    return sstep_sat(-(int32_t)a);
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_abs(sstep_real_t a)
{
    return sstep_sat((a < 0) ? -(int32_t)a : (int32_t)a);
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_mul(sstep_real_t a, sstep_real_t b)
{
    int32_t p = (int32_t)a * (int32_t)b; /* |p| <= 2^30: no overflow */
    return sstep_sat(sstep_asr(p + 0x4000, 15U));
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_from_real(sstep_real_t a)
{
    return (sstep_acc_t)a;
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_acc_to_real(sstep_acc_t a)
{
    return sstep_sat(a);
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_add(sstep_acc_t a, sstep_acc_t b)
{
    sstep_acc_t r;
    if ((b > 0) && (a > (INT32_MAX - b)))
    {
        r = INT32_MAX;
    }
    else if ((b < 0) && (a < (INT32_MIN - b)))
    {
        r = INT32_MIN;
    }
    else
    {
        r = a + b;
    }
    return r;
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_clamp(sstep_acc_t x, sstep_acc_t lo, sstep_acc_t hi)
{
    sstep_acc_t r = x;
    if (r > hi)
    {
        r = hi;
    }
    else if (r < lo)
    {
        r = lo;
    }
    else
    {
        /* in range */
    }
    return r;
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_gain_mul(const struct sstep_gain* g, sstep_real_t x)
{
    int32_t p = (int32_t)x * (int32_t)g->mant;                 /* Q30, |p| <= 2^30 */
    uint32_t sh = (uint32_t)(15 - (int32_t)g->exp);            /* 0 .. 31 */
    int32_t r;
    if (sh == 0U)
    {
        r = p;
    }
    else
    {
        r = sstep_asr(sstep_asr(p, sh - 1U) + 1, 1U); /* round half up, no overflow */
    }
    return r;
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_gain_mul_int(const struct sstep_gain* g, int32_t n)
{
    int32_t p = (int32_t)sstep_sat(n) * (int32_t)g->mant; /* |p| <= 2^30 */
    int32_t e = (int32_t)g->exp;
    int32_t r;
    if (e >= 0)
    {
        int32_t lim = sstep_asr(INT32_MAX, (uint32_t)e);
        if (p > lim)
        {
            r = INT32_MAX;
        }
        else if (p < -lim)
        {
            r = INT32_MIN;
        }
        else
        {
            r = p * (int32_t)((uint32_t)1U << (uint32_t)e); /* |p| <= lim: no overflow */
        }
    }
    else
    {
        uint32_t sh = (uint32_t)(-e); /* 1 .. 16 */
        r = sstep_asr(sstep_asr(p, sh - 1U) + 1, 1U);
    }
    return r;
}


static inline int32_t sstep_shift_round(int32_t p, int32_t sh)
{
    int32_t r;
    if (sh > 0)
    {
        r = sstep_asr(sstep_asr(p, (uint32_t)(sh - 1)) + 1, 1U);
    }
    else if (sh == 0)
    {
        r = p;
    }
    else
    {
        uint32_t n = (uint32_t)(-sh);
        int32_t lim = sstep_asr(INT32_MAX, n);
        if (p > lim)
        {
            r = INT32_MAX;
        }
        else if (p < -lim)
        {
            r = INT32_MIN;
        }
        else
        {
            r = p * (int32_t)((uint32_t)1U << n); /* |p| <= lim: no overflow */
        }
    }
    return r;
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_abs(sstep_acc_t a)
{
    return (a < 0) ? ((a == INT32_MIN) ? INT32_MAX : -a) : a;
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_halve(sstep_acc_t a)
{
    return sstep_asr(a, 1U);
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_in(sstep_acc_t x)
{
    return sstep_acc_clamp(x, -SSTEP_ACC_IN_MAX, SSTEP_ACC_IN_MAX);
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_gain_mul_acc(const struct sstep_gain* g, sstep_acc_t x)
{
    int32_t p = sstep_asr(sstep_acc_in(x), 2U) * (int32_t)g->mant; /* |p| < 2^30 */
    return sstep_shift_round(p, 13 - (int32_t)g->exp);
}

static inline sstep_integ_t sstep_integ_add(sstep_integ_t integ, const struct sstep_gain* g,
                                            sstep_real_t x)
{
    int32_t p = (int32_t)x * (int32_t)g->mant; /* Q30, |p| <= 2^30 */
    return sstep_acc_add(integ, sstep_shift_round(p, 3 - (int32_t)g->exp));
}

static inline sstep_integ_t sstep_integ_add_acc(sstep_integ_t integ, const struct sstep_gain* g,
                                                sstep_acc_t x)
{
    int32_t p = sstep_asr(sstep_acc_in(x), 2U) * (int32_t)g->mant;
    return sstep_acc_add(integ, sstep_shift_round(p, 1 - (int32_t)g->exp));
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_integ_to_acc(sstep_integ_t integ)
{
    return sstep_shift_round(integ, SSTEP_INTEG_FRAC_BITS - SSTEP_REAL_FRAC_BITS);
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_div_unit(sstep_acc_t num, sstep_acc_t den)
{
    uint32_t n = (uint32_t)num;
    uint32_t d = (uint32_t)den;
    uint32_t r;
    while (d >= 65536U) /* at most 16 iterations; keeps n << 15 below 2^31 */
    {
        n >>= 1U;
        d >>= 1U;
    }
    r = ((n << 15U) + (d >> 1U)) / d;
    if (r > 32767U)
    {
        r = 32767U;
    }
    return (sstep_real_t)r;
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_scale(sstep_acc_t x, sstep_real_t k)
{
    int32_t xc = sstep_acc_clamp(x, -SSTEP_ACC_SCALE_MAX, SSTEP_ACC_SCALE_MAX);
    return sstep_shift_round(xc * (int32_t)k, 15); /* |xc * k| < 2^31 */
}

static inline uint16_t sstep_acc_to_ticks(sstep_acc_t duty, uint16_t period)
{
    uint32_t d = (uint32_t)sstep_acc_clamp(duty, 0, SSTEP_ACC_ONE);
    return (uint16_t)(((d * (uint32_t)period) + 16384U) >> 15U);
}

/* ==============================================================================
 * FLOAT OPERATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

#else /* SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FLOAT */

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_sat_f(float x)
{
    float r = x;
    if (r > SSTEP_REAL_MAX)
    {
        r = SSTEP_REAL_MAX;
    }
    else if (r < SSTEP_REAL_MIN)
    {
        r = SSTEP_REAL_MIN;
    }
    else
    {
        /* in range */
    }
    return r;
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_add(sstep_real_t a, sstep_real_t b)
{
    return sstep_sat_f(a + b);
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_sub(sstep_real_t a, sstep_real_t b)
{
    return sstep_sat_f(a - b);
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_neg(sstep_real_t a)
{
    return sstep_sat_f(-a);
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_abs(sstep_real_t a)
{
    return sstep_sat_f((a < 0.0f) ? -a : a);
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_mul(sstep_real_t a, sstep_real_t b)
{
    return sstep_sat_f(a * b);
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_from_real(sstep_real_t a)
{
    return a;
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_acc_to_real(sstep_acc_t a)
{
    return sstep_sat_f(a);
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_clamp(sstep_acc_t x, sstep_acc_t lo, sstep_acc_t hi)
{
    sstep_acc_t r = x;
    if (r > hi)
    {
        r = hi;
    }
    else if (r < lo)
    {
        r = lo;
    }
    else
    {
        /* in range */
    }
    return r;
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_add(sstep_acc_t a, sstep_acc_t b)
{
    return sstep_acc_clamp(a + b, SSTEP_ACC_MIN, SSTEP_ACC_MAX);
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_gain_mul(const struct sstep_gain* g, sstep_real_t x)
{
    return sstep_acc_clamp(g->value * x, SSTEP_ACC_MIN, SSTEP_ACC_MAX);
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_gain_mul_int(const struct sstep_gain* g, int32_t n)
{
    int32_t k = n;
    if (k > (int32_t)INT16_MAX)
    {
        k = (int32_t)INT16_MAX;
    }

{
    return (a < 0.0f) ? -a : a;
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_halve(sstep_acc_t a)
{
    return a * 0.5f;
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_in(sstep_acc_t x)
{
    return sstep_acc_clamp(x, -SSTEP_ACC_IN_MAX, SSTEP_ACC_IN_MAX);
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_gain_mul_acc(const struct sstep_gain* g, sstep_acc_t x)
{
    return sstep_acc_clamp(g->value * sstep_acc_in(x), SSTEP_ACC_MIN, SSTEP_ACC_MAX);
}

static inline sstep_integ_t sstep_integ_add(sstep_integ_t integ, const struct sstep_gain* g,
                                            sstep_real_t x)
{
    return sstep_acc_clamp(integ + (g->value * x), -16.0f, 15.999999f);
}

static inline sstep_integ_t sstep_integ_add_acc(sstep_integ_t integ, const struct sstep_gain* g,
                                                sstep_acc_t x)
{
    return sstep_acc_clamp(integ + (g->value * sstep_acc_in(x)), -16.0f, 15.999999f);
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_integ_to_acc(sstep_integ_t integ)
{
    return integ;
}

static inline sstep_real_t sstep_div_unit(sstep_acc_t num, sstep_acc_t den)
{
    return sstep_sat_f(num / den);
}

static inline sstep_acc_t sstep_acc_scale(sstep_acc_t x, sstep_real_t k)
{
    return sstep_acc_clamp(x, -SSTEP_ACC_SCALE_MAX, SSTEP_ACC_SCALE_MAX) * k;
}

static inline uint16_t sstep_acc_to_ticks(sstep_acc_t duty, uint16_t period)
{
    float d = sstep_acc_clamp(duty, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    return (uint16_t)((d * (float)period) + 0.5f);
}

    if (r > hi)
    {

    }
    else if (r < lo)

    }

#include "sstep_internal.h"

/* ==============================================================================
 * DEFINES & MACROS
 * =============================================================================*/

#define ACC_HALF SSTEP_ACC_C(0.5)

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE FUNCTION DECLARATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

static sstep_acc_t acc_max(sstep_acc_t a, sstep_acc_t b);
#if (SSTEP_CFG_TOPOLOGY_SHARED_LEG == 1)
static sstep_acc_t acc_min(sstep_acc_t a, sstep_acc_t b);
#endif
static sstep_acc_t scale_to_unit(sstep_acc_t x, sstep_acc_t m);
#if (SSTEP_CFG_TOPOLOGY_FULL_BRIDGE == 1)
static sstep_acc_t span_full(sstep_acc_t a, sstep_acc_t b);
static void duties_full(sstep_acc_t a, sstep_acc_t b, uint16_t period, struct sstep_bridge_out* out);
#endif
#if (SSTEP_CFG_TOPOLOGY_SHARED_LEG == 1)
static sstep_acc_t span_shared(sstep_acc_t a, sstep_acc_t b);
static void duties_shared(sstep_acc_t a, sstep_acc_t b, uint16_t period,
                          struct sstep_bridge_out* out);
#endif

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

static sstep_acc_t acc_max(sstep_acc_t a, sstep_acc_t b)
{
    return (a > b) ? a : b;
}

#if (SSTEP_CFG_TOPOLOGY_SHARED_LEG == 1)
static sstep_acc_t acc_min(sstep_acc_t a, sstep_acc_t b)
{
    return (a < b) ? a : b;
}
#endif

static sstep_acc_t scale_to_unit(sstep_acc_t x, sstep_acc_t m)
{
    sstep_acc_t q = sstep_acc_from_real(sstep_div_unit(sstep_acc_abs(x), m));
    return (x < SSTEP_ACC_C(0.0)) ? -q : q;
}

#if (SSTEP_CFG_TOPOLOGY_FULL_BRIDGE == 1)

static sstep_acc_t span_full(sstep_acc_t a, sstep_acc_t b)
{
    return acc_max(sstep_acc_abs(a), sstep_acc_abs(b));
}

static void duties_full(sstep_acc_t a, sstep_acc_t b, uint16_t period, struct sstep_bridge_out* out)
{
    sstep_acc_t ha = sstep_acc_halve(a);
    sstep_acc_t hb = sstep_acc_halve(b);
    out->compare[0] = sstep_acc_to_ticks(ACC_HALF + ha, period);
    out->compare[1] = sstep_acc_to_ticks(ACC_HALF - ha, period);
    out->compare[2] = sstep_acc_to_ticks(ACC_HALF + hb, period);
    out->compare[3] = sstep_acc_to_ticks(ACC_HALF - hb, period);
}

#endif

#if (SSTEP_CFG_TOPOLOGY_SHARED_LEG == 1)

static sstep_acc_t span_shared(sstep_acc_t a, sstep_acc_t b)
{
    return acc_max(acc_max(a, b), SSTEP_ACC_C(0.0)) - acc_min(acc_min(a, b), SSTEP_ACC_C(0.0));
}

static void duties_shared(sstep_acc_t a, sstep_acc_t b, uint16_t period,
                          struct sstep_bridge_out* out)
{
    sstep_acc_t hi = acc_max(acc_max(a, b), SSTEP_ACC_C(0.0));
    sstep_acc_t lo = acc_min(acc_min(a, b), SSTEP_ACC_C(0.0));
    sstep_acc_t w = ACC_HALF - sstep_acc_halve(hi + lo);
    out->compare[0] = sstep_acc_to_ticks(a + w, period);
    out->compare[1] = sstep_acc_to_ticks(b + w, period);
    out->compare[2] = sstep_acc_to_ticks(w, period);
    out->compare[3] = 0U;
}

#endif

/* ==============================================================================
 * PUBLIC FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS (library internal)
 * =============================================================================*/

void sstep_bridge_map(enum sstep_topology topology, sstep_acc_t va, sstep_acc_t vb,
                      const struct sstep_gain* inv_vbus, sstep_acc_t vbus, uint16_t period,
                      struct sstep_bridge_out* out)
{
    sstep_acc_t x = va;
    sstep_acc_t y = vb;
    sstep_acc_t m0 = acc_max(sstep_acc_abs(va), sstep_acc_abs(vb));
    sstep_acc_t a;
    sstep_acc_t b;
    sstep_acc_t m;

    /* Power-of-two pre-scale keeps the direction exactly and the request below 4 pu,
       the input range of the multiplication by V_base / Vbus (Vbus <= 2 pu, so a
       pre-scaled request is always limited below). Bounded: fixed point at most 14
       halvings (2^31 / 2^17); float at most 18 (the PI output is below 2^20 pu). */
    while (m0 > SSTEP_ACC_IN_MAX)
    {
        x = sstep_acc_halve(x);
        y = sstep_acc_halve(y);
        m0 = sstep_acc_halve(m0);
    }

    /* relative to the bus voltage: 1.0 = Vbus */
    a = sstep_gain_mul_acc(inv_vbus, x);
    b = sstep_gain_mul_acc(inv_vbus, y);

#if (SSTEP_CFG_TOPOLOGY_FULL_BRIDGE == 1) && (SSTEP_CFG_TOPOLOGY_SHARED_LEG == 1)
    m = (topology == SSTEP_TOPOLOGY_FULL_BRIDGE) ? span_full(a, b) : span_shared(a, b);
#elif (SSTEP_CFG_TOPOLOGY_FULL_BRIDGE == 1)
    (void)topology;
    m = span_full(a, b);
#else
    (void)topology;
    m = span_shared(a, b);
#endif

    out->limited = (m > SSTEP_ACC_ONE);
    if (out->limited)
    {
        a = scale_to_unit(a, m);
        b = scale_to_unit(b, m);
        /* applied voltage in pu of V_base: a * Vbus */
        out->v[0] = sstep_acc_scale(vbus, sstep_acc_to_real(a));
        out->v[1] = sstep_acc_scale(vbus, sstep_acc_to_real(b));
    }
    else
    {
        out->v[0] = va;
        out->v[1] = vb;
    }

#if (SSTEP_CFG_TOPOLOGY_FULL_BRIDGE == 1) && (SSTEP_CFG_TOPOLOGY_SHARED_LEG == 1)
    if (topology == SSTEP_TOPOLOGY_FULL_BRIDGE)
    {
        duties_full(a, b, period, out);
    }
    else
    {
        duties_shared(a, b, period, out);
    }
#elif (SSTEP_CFG_TOPOLOGY_FULL_BRIDGE == 1)
    duties_full(a, b, period, out);
#else
    duties_shared(a, b, period, out);
#endif
}

static uint8_t log2_u32(uint32_t v)
{
    uint8_t n = 0U;
    uint32_t x = v;
    while (x > 1U)
    {
        x >>= 1U;
        n++;
    }
    return n;
}

static bool mul_ok(uint64_t a, uint64_t b, uint64_t* out)
{
    bool ok = (a == 0U) || (b < (RATIO_LIMIT / a));
    *out = ok ? (a * b) : 0U;
    return ok;
}

static int ratio(uint64_t n1, uint64_t n2, uint64_t d1, uint64_t d2, struct sstep_gain* g)

    if (mul_ok(n1, n2, &n) && mul_ok(d1, d2, &d))
    {
        result = (sstep_gain_from_ratio64((int64_t)n, (int64_t)d, g) == SSTEP_OK)
                     ? SSTEP_OK
                     : SSTEP_ERR_CONFIG;
    }
    return result;
}

static int64_t div_round(int64_t num, int64_t den)
{
    return (num >= 0) ? ((num + (den / 2)) / den) : -((-num + (den / 2)) / den);
}

static sstep_real_t gain_apply_i32(const struct sstep_gain* g, int32_t v)
{
#if (SSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND == SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FIXED)
    int64_t p = (int64_t)v * (int64_t)g->mant; /* value * 2^15 = p * 2^exp */
    int64_t q;
    if (g->exp >= 0)
    {
        q = p * ((int64_t)1 << (uint32_t)g->exp); /* |p| < 2^46, exp <= 15 */
    }
    else
    {
        q = div_round(p, (int64_t)1 << (uint32_t)(-g->exp));
    }
    if (q > (int64_t)INT16_MAX)
    {
        q = (int64_t)INT16_MAX;
    }
    else if (q < (int64_t)INT16_MIN)
    {
        q = (int64_t)INT16_MIN;
    }
    else
    {
        /* in range */
    }
    return (sstep_real_t)q;
#else
    return sstep_sat_f(g->value * (float)v);
#endif
}

static sstep_angle_t raw_angle(const struct sstep* m, int64_t pos)
{
    return (sstep_angle_t)(((uint64_t)pos) << m->angle_shift); /* modulo one turn */
}

static int check_config(const struct sstep_config* cfg)
{
    const struct sstep_motor_cfg* mo = &cfg->motor;
    const struct sstep_stage_cfg* st = &cfg->stage;
    const struct sstep_ctrl_cfg* c = &cfg->ctrl;
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if ((cfg->hal.pwm_write == NULL) || (cfg->hal.output_enable == NULL) ||
        (mo->r_mohm == 0U) || (mo->r_mohm > VALUE_MAX) || (mo->l_uh == 0U) ||
        (mo->l_uh > VALUE_MAX) || (mo->i_rated_ma == 0U) || (mo->i_rated_ma > VALUE_MAX) ||
        (mo->ke_uv_s_per_rad > VALUE_MAX) || (mo->full_steps_per_rev == 0U) ||
        ((st->topology != SSTEP_TOPOLOGY_FULL_BRIDGE) &&
         (st->topology != SSTEP_TOPOLOGY_SHARED_LEG)) ||
        (st->vbus_nominal_mv == 0U) || (st->vbus_nominal_mv > VALUE_MAX) ||
        (st->vbus_min_mv > VALUE_MAX) || (st->vbus_max_mv > VALUE_MAX) ||
        (st->i_full_scale_ma == 0U) || (st->i_full_scale_ma > VALUE_MAX) ||
        (st->i_trip_ma == 0U) || (st->pwm_period_ticks < 2U) || (st->adc_i_span == 0) ||
        (st->adc_i_span > 65535) || (st->adc_i_span < -65535) || (st->adc_full == 0U) ||
        (st->adc_i_zero > st->adc_full) || (st->adc_vbus_mv_full == 0U) ||
        (st->adc_vbus_mv_full > VALUE_MAX) ||
        ((c->drive_mode != SSTEP_DRIVE_CURRENT) && (c->drive_mode != SSTEP_DRIVE_VOLTAGE)) ||
        (c->fast_loop_hz == 0U) || (c->slow_loop_hz == 0U) || (c->fast_loop_hz > VALUE_MAX) ||
        (!is_pow2(c->microsteps)) || (c->microsteps > SSTEP_CFG_MICROSTEPS_MAX) ||
        (c->current_bw_hz == 0U) || (c->i_run_ma == 0U) || (c->v_max == 0U) ||
        (c->accel == 0U))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
#if (SSTEP_CFG_TOPOLOGY_FULL_BRIDGE == 0)
    else if (st->topology == SSTEP_TOPOLOGY_FULL_BRIDGE)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_UNSUPPORTED;
    }
#endif
#if (SSTEP_CFG_TOPOLOGY_SHARED_LEG == 0)
    else if (st->topology == SSTEP_TOPOLOGY_SHARED_LEG)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_UNSUPPORTED;
    }
#endif
    else if ((st->i_trip_ma > st->i_full_scale_ma) ||
             ((c->fast_loop_hz % c->slow_loop_hz) != 0U) ||
             ((c->fast_loop_hz / c->slow_loop_hz) > 65535U) ||
             (c->current_bw_hz > (c->fast_loop_hz / 4U)) ||
             ((st->vbus_min_mv != 0U) && (st->vbus_min_mv >= st->vbus_nominal_mv)) ||
             ((st->vbus_max_mv != 0U) && (st->vbus_max_mv <= st->vbus_nominal_mv)))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_CONFIG;
    }
    else
    {
        /* consistent */
    }
    return result;
}

static int set_currents(struct sstep* m, uint32_t run_ma, uint32_t hold_ma)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;
    sstep_real_t run;
    sstep_real_t hold;

    if ((run_ma == 0U) || (run_ma > VALUE_MAX) || (hold_ma > VALUE_MAX))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if ((hold_ma > run_ma) || (run_ma > m->cfg.stage.i_trip_ma) ||
             (run_ma > m->cfg.motor.i_rated_ma))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_CONFIG;
    }
    else
    {
        int32_t base = (int32_t)m->cfg.stage.i_full_scale_ma;
        (void)sstep_real_from_ratio((int32_t)run_ma, base, &run);  /* base > 0 */
        (void)sstep_real_from_ratio((int32_t)hold_ma, base, &hold);
        m->i_run = run;
        m->i_hold = hold;
        m->cfg.ctrl.i_run_ma = run_ma;
        m->cfg.ctrl.i_hold_ma = hold_ma;
    }
    return result;
}

static int set_limits(struct sstep* m, uint32_t v_max, uint32_t accel, uint32_t decel)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;
    int64_t f = (int64_t)m->cfg.ctrl.slow_loop_hz;
    uint32_t dec_in = (decel == 0U) ? accel : decel;
    int64_t vq = div_round((int64_t)v_max * SSTEP_POS_ONE, f);
    int64_t aq = div_round((int64_t)accel * SSTEP_POS_ONE, f * f);
    int64_t dq = div_round((int64_t)dec_in * SSTEP_POS_ONE, f * f);

    if ((v_max == 0U) || (accel == 0U) || (vq < 1) || (vq >= Q16_LIMIT) || (aq < 1) ||
        (aq >= Q16_LIMIT) || (dq < 1) || (dq >= Q16_LIMIT))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else
    {
        m->mo.v_max = (int32_t)vq;
        m->mo.acc = (int32_t)aq;
        m->mo.dec = (int32_t)dq;
        m->mo.brake_vmax = (vq * vq) / (2 * dq);
        m->cfg.ctrl.v_max = v_max;
        m->cfg.ctrl.accel = accel;
        m->cfg.ctrl.decel = decel;
    }
    return result;
}

static int derive(struct sstep* m)
{
    const struct sstep_motor_cfg* mo = &m->cfg.motor;
    const struct sstep_stage_cfg* st = &m->cfg.stage;
    const struct sstep_ctrl_cfg* c = &m->cfg.ctrl;
    uint64_t span = (uint64_t)((st->adc_i_span < 0) ? -st->adc_i_span : st->adc_i_span);
    uint64_t bw2pi = (uint64_t)c->current_bw_hz * TWO_PI_NUM;
    uint64_t vmv = st->vbus_nominal_mv;
    uint64_t trip = ((uint64_t)st->i_trip_ma * span) / st->i_full_scale_ma;
    uint64_t vmax_raw = ((uint64_t)st->vbus_max_mv * st->adc_full) / st->adc_vbus_mv_full;
    uint64_t vmin_raw = (((uint64_t)st->vbus_min_mv * st->adc_full) + st->adc_vbus_mv_full - 1U) /
                        st->adc_vbus_mv_full;
    int result;

    /* Kp = L wc I_base / V_base, Ki Ts = R wc Ts I_base / V_base, Kb = Ts R / L */
    result = ratio((uint64_t)mo->l_uh * st->i_full_scale_ma, bw2pi,
                   (uint64_t)TWO_PI_DEN * 1000000U, vmv, &m->kp);
    if (result == SSTEP_OK)
    {
        result = ratio((uint64_t)mo->r_mohm * st->i_full_scale_ma, bw2pi,
                       (uint64_t)TWO_PI_DEN * 1000U, (uint64_t)c->fast_loop_hz * vmv, &m->ki);
    }
    if (result == SSTEP_OK)
    {
        result = ratio(mo->r_mohm, 1000U, c->fast_loop_hz, mo->l_uh, &m->kb);
    }
    if (result == SSTEP_OK)
    {
        result = ratio(mo->r_mohm, st->i_full_scale_ma, 1000U, vmv, &m->r_pu);
    }
    if (result == SSTEP_OK)
    {
        result = ratio(1U, 1U, span, 1U, &m->adc_i);
        if (st->adc_i_span < 0)
        {
#if (SSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND == SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FIXED)
            m->adc_i.mant = (int16_t)(-m->adc_i.mant);
#else
            m->adc_i.value = -m->adc_i.value;
#endif
        }
    }
    if (result == SSTEP_OK)
    {
        result = ratio(st->adc_vbus_mv_full, 1U, st->adc_full, vmv, &m->adc_v);
    }
    if (result == SSTEP_OK)
    {
        /* back-EMF per microstep/s: Kt 2 pi / (Ns M) / V_base */
        result = ratio(mo->ke_uv_s_per_rad, TWO_PI_NUM,
                       (uint64_t)TWO_PI_DEN * mo->full_steps_per_rev * c->microsteps,
                       vmv * 1000U, &m->ff_gain);
    }
    /* trip <= span <= 65535 because i_trip_ma <= i_full_scale_ma (check_config) */
    if ((result == SSTEP_OK) && (trip == 0U))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_CONFIG;
    }
    if (result == SSTEP_OK)
    {
        result = set_currents(m, c->i_run_ma, c->i_hold_ma);
    }
    if (result == SSTEP_OK)
    {
        result = set_limits(m, c->v_max, c->accel, c->decel);
    }
    if (result == SSTEP_OK)
    {
        m->i_trip_counts = (uint16_t)trip;
        m->vbus_max_raw = (uint16_t)((vmax_raw > 65535U) ? 65535U : vmax_raw);
        m->vbus_min_raw = (uint16_t)((vmin_raw > 65535U) ? 65535U : vmin_raw);
        m->ratio = (uint16_t)(c->fast_loop_hz / c->slow_loop_hz);
        m->hold_ticks = (uint32_t)(((uint64_t)c->hold_delay_ms * c->slow_loop_hz) / 1000U);
        m->angle_shift = (uint8_t)(14U - log2_u32(c->microsteps));
        (void)sstep_gain_from_ratio(1, 1, &m->inv_vbus); /* nominal until measured */
    }
    return result;
}

static void shutdown(struct sstep* m, uint16_t faults)
{
    m->faults = (uint16_t)(m->faults | faults);
    m->state = SSTEP_STATE_FAULT;
    (void)m->cfg.hal.output_enable(m->cfg.hal.context, false);
    if (m->cfg.hal.on_fault != NULL)
    {
        m->cfg.hal.on_fault(m->cfg.hal.context, faults);
    }
}

static void publish(struct sstep* m, const struct sstep_setpoint* sp)
{
    uint8_t w;
    m->sp_pending = 0U;
    w = (uint8_t)(1U - m->sp_active);
    m->sp[w] = *sp;
    m->sp_pending = 1U;
}

static bool is_active(enum sstep_state s)
{
    return (s == SSTEP_STATE_HOLDING) || (s == SSTEP_STATE_MOVING);
}

static bool is_moving(const struct sstep* m)
{
    return (m->mo.mode != SSTEP_MODE_HOLD);
}

static void control(struct sstep* m)
{
    struct sstep_sincos sc;
    sstep_real_t iref[2];
    sstep_acc_t ff[2];
    sstep_acc_t vu[2];
    sstep_real_t e[2];
    struct sstep_bridge_out out;
    sstep_acc_t vbus;

    if (m->sp_pending != 0U)
    {
        m->sp_active = (uint8_t)(1U - m->sp_active);
        m->cur = m->sp[m->sp_active];
        m->adv = 0U;
        m->sp_pending = 0U;
    }

    sc = sstep_sin_cos(m->cur.angle);
    iref[0] = sstep_mul(m->cur.i_amp, sc.cos);
    iref[1] = sstep_mul(m->cur.i_amp, sc.sin);
    ff[0] = sstep_acc_from_real(sstep_neg(sstep_mul(m->cur.ff, sc.sin)));
    ff[1] = sstep_acc_from_real(sstep_mul(m->cur.ff, sc.cos));

    if (m->cfg.ctrl.drive_mode == SSTEP_DRIVE_CURRENT)
    {
        for (uint32_t k = 0U; k < 2U; k++)
        {
            e[k] = sstep_sub(iref[k], m->i_meas[k]);
            vu[k] = sstep_acc_add(sstep_acc_add(sstep_gain_mul(&m->kp, e[k]),
                                                sstep_integ_to_acc(m->integ[k])),
                                  ff[k]);
        }
    }
    else
    {
        for (uint32_t k = 0U; k < 2U; k++)
        {
            vu[k] = sstep_acc_add(sstep_gain_mul(&m->r_pu, iref[k]), ff[k]);
        }
    }

    vbus = sstep_acc_clamp(sstep_gain_mul_int(&m->adc_v, (int32_t)m->vbus_raw), SSTEP_ACC_C(0.0),
                           VBUS_PU_MAX);
    sstep_bridge_map(m->cfg.stage.topology, vu[0], vu[1], &m->cur.inv_vbus, vbus,
                     m->cfg.stage.pwm_period_ticks, &out);

    if (m->cfg.ctrl.drive_mode == SSTEP_DRIVE_CURRENT)
    {
        /* integ += Ki Ts e + Ts / Tt (v_applied - v_requested) */
        for (uint32_t k = 0U; k < 2U; k++)
        {
            m->integ[k] = sstep_integ_add(m->integ[k], &m->ki, e[k]);
            if (out.limited)
            {
                m->integ[k] = sstep_integ_add_acc(m->integ[k], &m->kb,
                                                  sstep_acc_add(out.v[k], -vu[k]));
            }
        }
    }

    for (uint32_t k = 0U; k < SSTEP_LEGS_MAX; k++)
    {
        m->compare[k] = out.compare[k];
    }
    if (m->cfg.hal.pwm_write(m->cfg.hal.context, m->compare) < 0)
    {
        shutdown(m, SSTEP_FAULT_HAL);
    }
    else if (m->adv < m->ratio)
    {
        m->cur.angle += (sstep_angle_t)m->cur.dangle; /* modulo one turn */
        m->adv++;
    }
    else
    {
        /* the slow loop is late: hold the angle */
    }
}

/* ==============================================================================
 * PUBLIC FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

int sstep_init(struct sstep* m, const struct sstep_config* cfg)
{
    int result;

    if ((m == NULL) || (cfg == NULL))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else
    {
        result = check_config(cfg);
        if (result == SSTEP_OK)
        {
            *m = (struct sstep){0}; /* no <string.h> needed */
            m->cfg = *cfg;
            result = derive(m);
            m->state = SSTEP_STATE_DISABLED;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_enable(struct sstep* m)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (m->state == SSTEP_STATE_FAULT)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else if (m->state == SSTEP_STATE_DISABLED)
    {
        struct sstep_setpoint sp;
        m->mo.mode = SSTEP_MODE_HOLD;
        m->mo.vel = 0;
        m->mo.target = m->mo.pos;
        m->integ[0] = SSTEP_ACC_C(0.0);
        m->integ[1] = SSTEP_ACC_C(0.0);
        m->still = 0U;
        m->hold_active = false;
        sp.angle = raw_angle(m, m->mo.pos) + m->angle_offset;
        sp.dangle = 0;
        sp.i_amp = m->i_run;
        sp.ff = SSTEP_REAL_ZERO;
        sp.inv_vbus = m->inv_vbus;
        m->cur = sp;
        m->adv = 0U;
        m->sp_pending = 0U;
        if (m->cfg.hal.output_enable(m->cfg.hal.context, true) < 0)
        {
            shutdown(m, SSTEP_FAULT_HAL);
            result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
        }
        else
        {
            m->state = SSTEP_STATE_HOLDING;
        }
    }
    else
    {
        /* already enabled */
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_disable(struct sstep* m)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else
    {
        if (m->state != SSTEP_STATE_FAULT)
        {
            m->state = SSTEP_STATE_DISABLED;
        }
        if (m->cfg.hal.output_enable(m->cfg.hal.context, false) < 0)
        {
            shutdown(m, SSTEP_FAULT_HAL);
        }
        m->mo.mode = SSTEP_MODE_HOLD;
        m->mo.vel = 0;
        m->mo.target = m->mo.pos;
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_fast_loop(struct sstep* m, const struct sstep_sample* sample)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

#if (SSTEP_CFG_ARG_CHECKS == 1)
    if ((m == NULL) || (sample == NULL))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else
#endif
    {
        int32_t da = (int32_t)sample->i_a - (int32_t)m->cfg.stage.adc_i_zero;
        int32_t db = (int32_t)sample->i_b - (int32_t)m->cfg.stage.adc_i_zero;
        uint16_t faults = SSTEP_FAULT_NONE;

        m->i_meas[0] = sstep_acc_to_real(sstep_gain_mul_int(&m->adc_i, da));
        m->i_meas[1] = sstep_acc_to_real(sstep_gain_mul_int(&m->adc_i, db));
        m->vbus_raw = sample->vbus;

        if (is_active(m->state))
        {
            int32_t trip = (int32_t)m->i_trip_counts;
            if ((m->cfg.ctrl.drive_mode == SSTEP_DRIVE_CURRENT) &&
                ((da > trip) || (da < -trip) || (db > trip) || (db < -trip)))
            {
                faults |= SSTEP_FAULT_OVERCURRENT;
            }
            if ((m->vbus_max_raw != 0U) && (sample->vbus > m->vbus_max_raw))
            {
                faults |= SSTEP_FAULT_OVERVOLTAGE;
            }
            if ((m->vbus_min_raw != 0U) && (sample->vbus < m->vbus_min_raw))
            {
                faults |= SSTEP_FAULT_UNDERVOLTAGE;
            }

            if (faults != SSTEP_FAULT_NONE)
            {
                shutdown(m, faults);
            }
            else
            {
                control(m);
            }
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_slow_loop(struct sstep* m)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (is_active(m->state))
    {
        struct sstep_setpoint sp;
        int64_t p0 = m->mo.pos;
        int64_t dp;
        uint8_t flags = sstep_motion_step(&m->mo);
        uint16_t raw = m->vbus_raw;
        bool hold_event = false;

        if ((m->mo.mode == SSTEP_MODE_RUN) && (m->mo.v_run == 0) && (m->mo.vel == 0))
        {
            m->mo.mode = SSTEP_MODE_HOLD; /* stop completed */
            m->mo.target = m->mo.pos;
        }
        dp = m->mo.pos - p0;

        /* run current while moving, hold current after hold_delay periods without motion */
        if (dp != 0)
        {
            m->still = 0U;
            m->hold_active = false;
        }
        else
        {
            m->still++;
            if ((m->still >= m->hold_ticks) && (!m->hold_active))
            {
                m->hold_active = true;
                hold_event = true;
            }
        }

        if (raw != 0U)
        {
            struct sstep_gain inv;
            if (sstep_gain_from_ratio64((int64_t)m->cfg.stage.adc_full *
                                            (int64_t)m->cfg.stage.vbus_nominal_mv,
                                        (int64_t)raw * (int64_t)m->cfg.stage.adc_vbus_mv_full,
                                        &inv) == SSTEP_OK)
            {
                m->inv_vbus = inv;
            }
        }

        sp.angle = raw_angle(m, p0) + m->angle_offset;
        sp.dangle = (int32_t)((dp * ((int64_t)1 << m->angle_shift)) / (int64_t)m->ratio);
        sp.i_amp = m->hold_active ? m->i_hold : m->i_run;
        sp.ff = gain_apply_i32(&m->ff_gain,
                               (int32_t)div_round(dp * (int64_t)m->cfg.ctrl.slow_loop_hz,
                                                  SSTEP_POS_ONE));
        sp.inv_vbus = m->inv_vbus;
        publish(m, &sp);

        /* a fault raised by the fast loop meanwhile sets faults before the state */
        if (m->faults == SSTEP_FAULT_NONE)
        {
            m->state = is_moving(m) ? SSTEP_STATE_MOVING : SSTEP_STATE_HOLDING;
        }
        else
        {
            m->state = SSTEP_STATE_FAULT;
        }

        if (m->cfg.hal.on_event != NULL)
        {
            if ((flags & SSTEP_MOTION_DONE) != 0U)
            {
                m->cfg.hal.on_event(m->cfg.hal.context, SSTEP_EVENT_MOVE_DONE);
            }
            if (hold_event)
            {
                m->cfg.hal.on_event(m->cfg.hal.context, SSTEP_EVENT_HOLD_CURRENT);
            }
        }
    }
    else
    {
        m->mo.mode = SSTEP_MODE_HOLD;
        m->mo.vel = 0;
        m->mo.target = m->mo.pos;
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_move_to(struct sstep* m, int32_t position)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (!is_active(m->state))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else
    {
        m->mo.target = (int64_t)position * SSTEP_POS_ONE;
        m->mo.mode = SSTEP_MODE_MOVE;
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_move_by(struct sstep* m, int32_t delta)
{
    int result;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else
    {
        int64_t t = div_round(m->mo.target, SSTEP_POS_ONE) + (int64_t)delta;
        if ((t > (int64_t)INT32_MAX) || (t < (int64_t)INT32_MIN))
        {
            result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
        }
        else
        {
            result = sstep_move_to(m, (int32_t)t);
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_run(struct sstep* m, int32_t velocity)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if ((velocity > (int32_t)m->cfg.ctrl.v_max) || (velocity < -(int32_t)m->cfg.ctrl.v_max))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (!is_active(m->state))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else
    {
        m->mo.v_run = (int32_t)div_round((int64_t)velocity * SSTEP_POS_ONE,
                                         (int64_t)m->cfg.ctrl.slow_loop_hz);
        m->mo.mode = SSTEP_MODE_RUN;
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_stop(struct sstep* m)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (is_active(m->state) && is_moving(m))
    {
        m->mo.v_run = 0;
        m->mo.mode = SSTEP_MODE_RUN;
    }
    else
    {
        /* nothing to stop */
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_set_position(struct sstep* m, int32_t position)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (is_moving(m))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_STATE;
    }
    else
    {
        int64_t p = (int64_t)position * SSTEP_POS_ONE;
        /* keep the electrical angle: the rotor must not move */
        m->angle_offset += raw_angle(m, m->mo.pos) - raw_angle(m, p);
        m->mo.pos = p;
        m->mo.target = p;
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_set_current(struct sstep* m, uint32_t run_ma, uint32_t hold_ma)
{
    int result;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else
    {
        result = set_currents(m, run_ma, hold_ma);
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_set_motion_limits(struct sstep* m, uint32_t v_max, uint32_t accel, uint32_t decel)
{
    int result;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else
    {
        result = set_limits(m, v_max, accel, decel);
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_report_fault(struct sstep* m, uint16_t faults)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else if (faults != SSTEP_FAULT_NONE)
    {
        shutdown(m, faults);
    }
    else
    {
        /* nothing reported */
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_clear_faults(struct sstep* m)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if (m == NULL)
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else
    {
        m->faults = SSTEP_FAULT_NONE;
        m->state = SSTEP_STATE_DISABLED;
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_get_status(const struct sstep* m, struct sstep_status* status)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if ((m == NULL) || (status == NULL))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else
    {
        int32_t base = (int32_t)m->cfg.stage.i_full_scale_ma;
        status->state = m->state;
        status->faults = m->faults;
        status->position = (int32_t)div_round(m->mo.pos, SSTEP_POS_ONE);
        status->target = (int32_t)div_round(m->mo.target, SSTEP_POS_ONE);
        status->velocity = (int32_t)div_round((int64_t)m->mo.vel *
                                                  (int64_t)m->cfg.ctrl.slow_loop_hz,
                                              SSTEP_POS_ONE);
        status->i_a_ma = sstep_real_to_units(sstep_acc_from_real(m->i_meas[0]), base);
        status->i_b_ma = sstep_real_to_units(sstep_acc_from_real(m->i_meas[1]), base);
        status->vbus_mv = (uint32_t)(((uint64_t)m->vbus_raw * m->cfg.stage.adc_vbus_mv_full) /
                                     m->cfg.stage.adc_full);
    }
    return result;
}

#include "sstep_math.h"

#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>

#include "sstep_defs.h"
#include "sstep_sin_table.h"

/* ==============================================================================
 * DEFINES & MACROS
 * =============================================================================*/

#define QUADRANT_BITS 30U

#define QUADRANT_MASK 0x3FFFFFFFUL

#define FRAC_BITS (QUADRANT_BITS - SSTEP_CFG_SINE_TABLE_BITS)

#define RATIO64_LIMIT ((int64_t)1 << 62)

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE FUNCTION DECLARATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

static sstep_real_t quarter_sin(uint32_t pos);

#if (SSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND == SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FIXED)
static uint32_t bit_length(uint64_t v);
static uint64_t ratio_round(uint64_t n, uint64_t d, uint32_t s);
#endif

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

#if (SSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND == SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FIXED)

static uint32_t bit_length(uint64_t v)
{
    uint64_t x = v;
    uint32_t n = 0U;
    uint32_t step = 32U;
    while (step > 0U)
    {
        if ((x >> step) != 0U)
        {
            x >>= step;
            n += step;
        }
        step >>= 1U;
    }
    return n + (uint32_t)x; /* x is 0 or 1 here */
}

static uint64_t ratio_round(uint64_t n, uint64_t d, uint32_t s)
{
    return ((n << s) + (d / 2U)) / d;
}

static sstep_real_t quarter_sin(uint32_t pos)
{
    uint32_t idx = pos >> FRAC_BITS;
    /* the 15 most significant bits of the fraction (FRAC_BITS >= 20) */
    int32_t frac = (int32_t)((pos >> (FRAC_BITS - 15U)) & 0x7FFFUL);
    int32_t y0 = (int32_t)sstep_sin_table[idx];
    int32_t dy = (int32_t)sstep_sin_table[idx + 1U] - y0; /* |dy| < 2^10 */
    return (sstep_real_t)(y0 + sstep_asr((dy * frac) + 0x4000, 15U));
}

#else /* SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FLOAT */

#define FRAC_SCALE (1.0f / (float)(1UL << FRAC_BITS))

static sstep_real_t quarter_sin(uint32_t pos)
{
    uint32_t idx = pos >> FRAC_BITS;
    float frac = (float)(pos & ((1UL << FRAC_BITS) - 1UL)) * FRAC_SCALE;
    float y0 = sstep_sin_table[idx];
    return y0 + ((sstep_sin_table[idx + 1U] - y0) * frac);
}

#endif /* SSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND */

/* ==============================================================================
 * PUBLIC FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

struct sstep_sincos sstep_sin_cos(sstep_angle_t angle)
{
    uint32_t quadrant = angle >> QUADRANT_BITS;
    uint32_t pos = angle & QUADRANT_MASK;
    /* cos(pos) = sin(90 deg - pos); one angle LSB (2^-32 turn) less keeps the index
       below N, and makes sin(a + 90 deg) bit-exactly equal to cos(a). */
    sstep_real_t s = quarter_sin(pos);
    sstep_real_t c = quarter_sin(QUADRANT_MASK - pos);
    struct sstep_sincos r;

    switch (quadrant)
    {
    case 0U:
        r.sin = s;
        r.cos = c;
        break;
    case 1U:
        r.sin = c;
        r.cos = sstep_neg(s);
        break;
    case 2U:
        r.sin = sstep_neg(s);
        r.cos = sstep_neg(c);
        break;
    default: /* quadrant 3 */
        r.sin = sstep_neg(c);
        r.cos = s;
        break;
    }
    return r;
}

#if (SSTEP_CFG_MATH_BACKEND == SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FIXED)

int sstep_gain_from_ratio64(int64_t num, int64_t den, struct sstep_gain* gain)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if ((gain == NULL) || (den == 0) || (num >= RATIO64_LIMIT) || (num <= -RATIO64_LIMIT) ||
        (den >= RATIO64_LIMIT) || (den <= -RATIO64_LIMIT))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else
    {
        bool negative = ((num < 0) != (den < 0));
        uint64_t n = (num < 0) ? (uint64_t)(-num) : (uint64_t)num;
        uint64_t d = (den < 0) ? (uint64_t)(-den) : (uint64_t)den;
        uint32_t ld = bit_length(d);
        int32_t s;
        uint64_t m;

        if (ld > 47U)
        {
            /* keep n << s below 2^63; the relative error of d is below 2^-46 */
            n >>= (ld - 47U);
            d >>= (ld - 47U);
            ld = 47U;
        }

        /* estimate: n * 2^s / d in (2^13, 2^15], then correct by one step */
        s = 14 - (int32_t)bit_length(n) + (int32_t)ld;
        if (s < 0)
        {
            s = 0;
        }
        else if (s > 31)
        {
            s = 31;
        }
        else
        {
            /* in range */
        }
        m = ratio_round(n, d, (uint32_t)s);

        if (m > 32767U)
        {
            if (s == 0)
            {
                result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM; /* |num / den| above 32767 */
            }
            else
            {
                s--;
                m = ratio_round(n, d, (uint32_t)s);
            }
        }
        else if (s < 31)
        {
            uint64_t m2 = ratio_round(n, d, (uint32_t)s + 1U);
            if (m2 <= 32767U)
            {
                s++;
                m = m2;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            /* s = 31: smallest exponent */
        }

        if (result == SSTEP_OK)
        {
            if (m == 0U)
            {
                gain->mant = 0;
                gain->exp = (int8_t)SSTEP_GAIN_EXP_MIN;
            }
            else
            {
                int32_t mi = (int32_t)m;
                gain->mant = (int16_t)(negative ? -mi : mi);
                gain->exp = (int8_t)(15 - s);
            }
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_gain_from_ratio(int32_t num, int32_t den, struct sstep_gain* gain)
{
    return sstep_gain_from_ratio64((int64_t)num, (int64_t)den, gain);
}

int sstep_real_from_ratio(int32_t num, int32_t den, sstep_real_t* out)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if ((out == NULL) || (den == 0))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else
    {
        bool negative = ((num < 0) != (den < 0));
        uint64_t n = (num < 0) ? (uint64_t)(-(int64_t)num) : (uint64_t)num;
        uint64_t d = (den < 0) ? (uint64_t)(-(int64_t)den) : (uint64_t)den;
        uint64_t m = ((n << 15U) + (d / 2U)) / d;
        int32_t v;
        if (m > 32768U)
        {
            m = 32768U; /* saturate before the sign is applied */
        }
        v = (int32_t)m;
        *out = sstep_sat(negative ? -v : v);
    }
    return result;
}

int32_t sstep_real_to_units(sstep_acc_t x, int32_t base)
{
    int64_t p = (int64_t)x * (int64_t)base;
    uint64_t a = (p < 0) ? (uint64_t)(-p) : (uint64_t)p; /* |p| < 2^62 */
    uint64_t m = (a + 0x4000U) >> 15U;
    int64_t v = (p < 0) ? -(int64_t)m : (int64_t)m;
    int32_t result;

    if (v > (int64_t)INT32_MAX)
    {
        result = INT32_MAX;
    }
    else if (v < (int64_t)INT32_MIN)
    {
        result = INT32_MIN;
    }
    else
    {
        result = (int32_t)v;
    }
    return result;
}

#else /* SSTEP_MATH_BACKEND_FLOAT */

int sstep_gain_from_ratio64(int64_t num, int64_t den, struct sstep_gain* gain)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if ((gain == NULL) || (den == 0) || (num >= RATIO64_LIMIT) || (num <= -RATIO64_LIMIT) ||
        (den >= RATIO64_LIMIT) || (den <= -RATIO64_LIMIT))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else
    {
        float v = (float)num / (float)den;
        float a = (v < 0.0f) ? -v : v;
        /* same limit as the fixed point backend (round(|v|) <= 32767) */
        if (a >= 32767.5f)
        {
            result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
        }
        else
        {
            gain->value = v;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int sstep_gain_from_ratio(int32_t num, int32_t den, struct sstep_gain* gain)
{
    return sstep_gain_from_ratio64((int64_t)num, (int64_t)den, gain);
}

int sstep_real_from_ratio(int32_t num, int32_t den, sstep_real_t* out)
{
    int result = SSTEP_OK;

    if ((out == NULL) || (den == 0))
    {
        result = SSTEP_ERR_PARAM;
    }
    else
    {
        *out = sstep_sat_f((float)num / (float)den);
    }
    return result;
}

int32_t sstep_real_to_units(sstep_acc_t x, int32_t base)
{
    float v = x * (float)base;
    int32_t result;

    if (v >= 2147483520.0f) /* largest float below 2^31 */
    {
        result = INT32_MAX;
    }
    else if (v <= -2147483648.0f)
    {
        result = INT32_MIN;
    }
    else
    {
        result = (int32_t)((v < 0.0f) ? (v - 0.5f) : (v + 0.5f));

A move aims at the largest v_new for which the distance of this period, (v + v_new) / 2, plus the braking distance from v_new, v_new^2 / (2 dec), fits into the distance left: v_new = (-dec + sqrt(dec^2 + 8 dec |rem| - 4 dec |v|)) / 2. No overshoot; the velocity changes by at most acc or dec per period, except in the last period of a move, where the remaining v <= 2 dec (a few microsteps per second) drops to zero on the target.

/* ==============================================================================

#include "sstep_internal.h"

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE FUNCTION DECLARATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

static int32_t clamp_i32(int32_t v, int32_t lo, int32_t hi);
static int32_t abs_i32(int32_t v);
static int64_t abs_i64(int64_t v);
static int64_t half_floor(int64_t v);
static int32_t target_velocity(const struct sstep_motion* mo);

/* ==============================================================================
 * PRIVATE FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS
 * =============================================================================*/

static int32_t clamp_i32(int32_t v, int32_t lo, int32_t hi)
{
    int32_t r = v;
    if (r > hi)
    {
        r = hi;
    }
    else if (r < lo)
    {
        r = lo;
    }
    else
    {
        /* in range */
    }
    return r;
}

static int32_t abs_i32(int32_t v)
{
    return (v < 0) ? -v : v;
}

static int64_t abs_i64(int64_t v)
{
    return (v < 0) ? -v : v;
}

static int64_t half_floor(int64_t v)
{
    return (v >= 0) ? (v / 2) : -((1 - v) / 2);
}

static int32_t target_velocity(const struct sstep_motion* mo)
{
    int32_t vt;

    if (mo->mode == SSTEP_MODE_MOVE)
    {
        int64_t rem = mo->target - mo->pos;
        int64_t arem = abs_i64(rem);
        int64_t av = (int64_t)abs_i32(mo->vel);
        int64_t d = (int64_t)mo->dec;
        uint32_t mag;

        if (arem >= (mo->brake_vmax + (((int64_t)mo->v_max + av) / 2)))
        {
            mag = (uint32_t)mo->v_max;
        }
        else
        {
            /* arem < v_max^2 / (2 dec) + v_max: every term below 2^62. The root is below
               v_max here (it reaches v_max exactly at the threshold above). */
            int64_t disc = (d * d) + (8 * d * arem) - (4 * d * av);
            uint32_t root = (disc > 0) ? sstep_isqrt64((uint64_t)disc) : 0U;
            mag = (root > (uint32_t)d) ? ((root - (uint32_t)d) / 2U) : 0U;
        }

        if (rem > 0)
        {
            vt = (int32_t)mag;
        }
        else if (rem < 0)
        {
            vt = -(int32_t)mag;
        }
        else
        {
            vt = 0;
        }
    }
    else if (mo->mode == SSTEP_MODE_RUN)
    {
        vt = clamp_i32(mo->v_run, -mo->v_max, mo->v_max);
    }
    else
    {
        vt = 0;
    }
    return vt;
}

/* ==============================================================================
 * PUBLIC FUNCTION IMPLEMENTATIONS (library internal)
 * =============================================================================*/

uint32_t sstep_isqrt64(uint64_t x)
{
    uint64_t rem = x;
    uint64_t res = 0U;
    uint64_t bit = (uint64_t)1U << 62U;

    while (bit > rem)
    {
        bit >>= 2U;
    }
    while (bit != 0U)
    {
        if (rem >= (res + bit))
        {
            rem -= res + bit;
            res = (res >> 1U) + bit;
        }
        else
        {
            res >>= 1U;
        }
        bit >>= 2U;
    }
    return (uint32_t)res;
}

uint8_t sstep_motion_step(struct sstep_motion* mo)
{
    uint8_t result = 0U;
    int32_t vt = target_velocity(mo);
    /* speeding up: larger magnitude in the same direction (or from standstill) */
    bool speeding_up = (abs_i32(vt) > abs_i32(mo->vel)) &&
                       ((mo->vel == 0) || ((vt > 0) == (mo->vel > 0)));
    int32_t a = speeding_up ? mo->acc : mo->dec;
    int32_t v_new = mo->vel + clamp_i32(vt - mo->vel, -a, a);
    int64_t p_new = mo->pos + half_floor((int64_t)mo->vel + (int64_t)v_new);

    if (mo->mode == SSTEP_MODE_MOVE)
    {
        int64_t rem0 = mo->target - mo->pos;
        int64_t rem1 = mo->target - p_new;
        bool crossed = ((rem0 >= 0) && (rem1 <= 0)) || ((rem0 <= 0) && (rem1 >= 0));
        bool near = (abs_i64(rem1) < SSTEP_POS_SNAP) && (abs_i32(v_new) <= mo->dec);
        if (crossed || near)
        {
            p_new = mo->target;
            v_new = 0;
            mo->mode = SSTEP_MODE_HOLD;
            result = SSTEP_MOTION_DONE;
        }
    }

    mo->pos = p_new;
    mo->vel = v_new;
    return result;
}
